newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain says Qatar's claims over disputed islands threatens security in the Gulf.
- Tunisia plans to set up a new mobile phone network.
- Yemen studies the buidling of a gas pipeline from Marib to the capital Sanaa.
- Egyptian economy minister says stalemate in Middle East peace process blocks foreign investment in the area.
- Gulf bourses in a week - share index in Saudi Arabia and Kuwait drops, rises in Oman, Bahrain and United Arab Emirates.
- Arab Investment Company posts $19.3 million profit in eight months.
